settings.title: Flexible, Secure Ways to Pay
settings.subtitle: Shopping for fine jewelry should feel effortless. That’s why we offer multiple secure, convenient payment options—so you can choose the method that works best for you. Whether you prefer paying upfront, checking out quickly, or spreading payments over time, we make the process simple and protected from start to finish.

settings.text:
We accept all major credit cards for a fast, secure checkout experience. Your information is encrypted during every transaction, and we never store your credit card details on our servers. 

Accepted Cards:

  • Visa
  • Mastercard
  • American Express
  • Discover 

Paying by credit card also allows you to take advantage of your bank’s rewards programs, purchase protections, and extended warranties—ideal for meaningful purchases like engagement rings and fine jewelry.

We’ve partnered with Affirm™ to offer flexible financing options that make it easy to pay over time. Choose from simple monthly installment plans designed to fit your budget, with clear terms and no hidden fees.

With Affirm, you can:

  • Split your purchase into easy monthly payments
  • Enter a few pieces of information for a real-time decision – checking your eligibility won't affect your credit score
  • Know exactly what you'll owe before you commit, with no hidden fees
  • Securely complete your purchase in just a few clicks

Subject to credit check and approval. Limited payment options are available for purchases under $100. Affirm loans are made by Cross River Bank, a New Jersey State Chartered Commercial Bank, Member FDIC.

For a faster, more convenient shopping experience, we offer secure express checkout options that let you complete your purchase in just a few clicks.

Available Express Methods:

  • PayPal
  • Shop Pay
  • Apple Pay
  • Google Pay
  • Amazon Pay

These options allow you to use saved payment and shipping information, making checkout quick and effortless—especially on mobile.

For orders over $500, we accept domestic and international wire transfers—an excellent option for high-value purchases or customers who prefer direct bank payments.

Why choose a wire transfer:

  • Added security for large transactions
  • No spending limits (like credit cards)
  • Ideal for high purchase price

After placing your order, our team will provide detailed wire instructions and confirm your payment as soon as it’s received.

While most of us love wearing jewelry, not everyone is an expert in all the terminology about jewelry, diamonds, and gemstones. To help aid you in your jewelry journey, we've compiled a list of some of the most commonly used terms and phrases. Feel free to browse or search for definitions of some of these key terms.

settings.title: How do I safely clean my engagement ring at home?
settings.content: Mix warm water with a drop of mild dish soap, soak your ring for 10–15 minutes, then gently brush with a soft toothbrush—especially under the setting. Rinse with clean, lukewarm water and dry with a soft, lint-free cloth.

settings.title: How often should I clean my ring?
settings.content: For rings you wear every day, a quick at-home clean once a week helps prevent buildup from lotions, soap, and natural oils. If your ring still looks dull after cleaning, consider having a jeweler take a closer look.

settings.title: Is it safe to use household cleaners or toothpaste on my jewelry?
settings.content: No. Harsh chemicals and abrasive products like toothpaste or baking soda can damage metal and certain gemstones. Stick to warm water, mild soap, and a soft brush.

settings.title: Can I wear my ring while swimming or working out?
settings.content: It’s best to remove your jewelry before swimming, exercising, cleaning, or doing any activity where it could be exposed to chlorine, impact, or harsh products. This helps protect both the setting and the metal over time.

settings.title: When should I see a jeweler about my jewelry?
settings.content: Have a jeweler inspect your engagement ring and wedding band every 6–12 months, or any time you notice a loose stone, visible damage, or a sudden change in how your jewelry looks. If you’re unsure, you can always start by contacting us through our Contact Us page for guidance.
